propositions: Provider-prefixed model_ref strings (e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6, openai:gpt-5.4) passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError and are silently converted to unpriced rows, causing cost totals to exclude known models.

The asymmetric failure (Bedrock forms resolve via fuzzy match, Anthropic and OpenAI forms do not) biases provider cost comparisons by showing figures only for Bedrock while other providers appear blank.
Bare model identifiers without provider prefix (claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-5.4) resolve correctly in genai_prices, proving the issue is the prefix format rather than unknown models.

The fix must use registry membership to translate provider-qualified ids rather than naive prefix stripping or split operations, because Bedrock's remainder and versioned AWS ids like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 require context-aware handling.
Genuinely unknown models must remain tolerated as unpriced (best-effort policy) but be visibly distinguishable in output from mis-formatted ids.
